comments.text: MB map strip: 64 cells, one per world column, read as $0600,Y by resident $4173 and $3B51 (the map repeats through mask $3F). The low nibble of a cell selects its block type through the table at $073E. Columns 0 to 5 hold 00 03 00 07 00 09; the rest of the strip is zero.
192 bytes ($0640-$06FF) after the 64-cell strip, all zero except $06FF ($09). The map position is masked with $3F, so the scene never indexes these bytes.

Start of the 32-byte scene header that the loader at $557A unpacks after the map. The bytes are $50 42 2D 2D 00 00 00 09 0C 0B 08 08 08 08 55 42. The loader reads $0701 ($42, "B") as the name character of the picture P and character set C resources it loads to $BC00 and $E000, $070F ($42, "B") as the name character of the overlay U loaded to $8B00, and $0703 ($2D, "-") as the extra costume selector, where a dash means none. $0700 and $0702 are not read by the loader.

Three numeric header bytes: $0704 (0) is the loop limit the loader compares at $568F and is read by the camera and motion routines, $0705 (0) indexes the tables at $59A1 and $59A8 that set $5E, $5F and $60, and $0706 (0) is halved into $02C8 and $02C7 at $566A.

Seven colour bytes ($0707-$070D = 09 0C 0B 08 08 08 08) read by $5A34: $0708 and $0709 go to the VIC background colour registers $D022 and $D023, $0707 is cached at $02DD as the display colour, and $070A-$070D are copied to the four message palette bytes $6998-$699B.
Two bytes, "UB" ($55 $42): the overlay resource name, whose second character the loader compares with its cache at $508E and loads at $8B00 ($070F).

Ten bytes ($0710-$0719 = 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00): depth thresholds. $0710 is read by the object grid and placement routines ($37B4, $383F, $5487), $0711 at $548A, $0718 at $5397 and $0719 at $53B9.

Costume selector ($06), the index into the initial-animation table at $5985 read at $51EA and $5985. The three bytes after it ($071B-$071D = FF 12 FF) are read at $5201, $5207 and $51E4 when entry placement starts.

Sixteen replacement cell nibbles for OPEN, indexed by the current cell's low nibble. Bytes: 00 02 02 04 04 06 06 08 08 09 0A 0B 0C 0D 0E 0F. Nibbles that change: 1 becomes 2, 3 becomes 4, 5 becomes 6, 7 becomes 8.

Sixteen replacement cell nibbles for CLOSE, indexed by the current cell's low nibble. Bytes: 00 01 01 03 03 05 05 07 07 09 0A 0B 0C 0D 0E 0F. Nibbles that change: 2 becomes 1, 4 becomes 3, 6 becomes 5, 8 becomes 7.

Sixteen low-nibble-to-type values read by $4171/$4173 and $3B51 (bytes: 00 02 03 02 03 02 03 02 03 01 00 00 00 00 00 00). Types $80 and above are negative; the engine falls back to depth-table index zero for them.

Sixteen inclusive upper column bounds read by $4115 (bytes: 01 03 FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF FF). Resident $411C takes the first entry whose bound is at least the coarse column, so each region is the span of columns up to its bound.
Sixteen zero bytes ($075E-$076D) between the column thresholds and the selectors. The scan at $411C stops at index 15 ($075D), so it does not read them.

Sixteen source selectors, one per region (bytes: 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00). Resident $412B reads the one for the region found at $411C: 0 uses the region itself as the table index (bank 0), 1 takes bits $60 of the state byte $0500, 2 takes bits $60 of $0501, and 3 or more take bits $60 of the shared PRNG. The selected bank (0 to 3) is offset 32 bytes per bank into the exit arrays.
Scene requests of bank 0, one per region ($077E-$078D): region 0 requests scene 12; region 1 requests scene 15; the rest are zero. A request of 0 keeps the current scene.

Entry identifiers of bank 0, one per region ($078E-$079D): 01 02 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01 01. The entry belongs to the scene requested by the paired region (or this scene, when the request is 0).
Scene requests of bank 1, one per region ($079E-$07AD): all zero. A request of 0 keeps the current scene.

Entry identifiers of bank 1, one per region ($07AE-$07BD): 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00. The entry belongs to the scene requested by the paired region (or this scene, when the request is 0).
